title: Algebraic Speedups for Exact Inversion of Hamiltonian Evolutions
summary: Deterministic exact inversion of an arbitrary $d$-dimensional unitary requires {$Θ(d^2)$} coherent forward calls in the worst case. We ask how this cost changes for Hamiltonian evolution $U(x)=\exp(i\sum_j x_jH_j)$ when the generators are known but the parameters are hidden. For one-parameter families with a fixed eigenbasis, we show that additive relations among the distinct eigenvalues determine the optimal query number exactly, and we construct the corresponding inversion protocol.
